lead: Guessing what a backend emits costs a design; a throwaway `#[test]` that prints it costs one build.
body: The plausible answer for `nvs_codegen::compile_object`'s relocations — ELF-style `PltRelative` to helpers, needing a stub past 2 GB — is not what this host does: a COFF object routes every external reference through a `.rdata$.refptr` cell, so the only kinds are `Relative`/32 and `Absolute`/64, with implicit addends that must be added to `Relocation::addend()`. Delete the probe once it has answered and put what it found in the module doc.
